variant.title: Quadruple Sudoku
variant.description: Digits shown in a circle must appear in the four cells surrounding that intersection.
rule.quadruple: Each circled digit must appear in the four surrounding cells.
rule_guide.title: Quadruple Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Every digit shown in a white circle must appear in one of the four cells surrounding that intersection.
rule_guide.item_3: If a digit appears more than once in a circle, it must appear the same number of times in the surrounding cells.
rule_guide.item_4: A circle may show fewer than four digits; unshown digits and intersections without a circle add no extra restriction.
